summary: Chad Pallansch, 49, of Fort Collins, an experienced trail runner, disappeared on a 28-mile route through Rocky Mountain National Park; last text near Mount Alice around noon September 27; broad-scale multi-agency search suspended with no further clues; still missing.
location: Mount Alice area, Rocky Mountain National Park (East Inlet/North Inlet)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park SAR, Larimer County SAR, Grand County SAR, Rocky Mountain Rescue, Front Range Rescue Dogs, CSAR, Alpine Rescue Team, El Paso County SAR, DFPC, Northern Colorado Interagency Helitack, Trans Aero
notes: Still missing as of NPS release; presumed deceased per index convention for unrecovered missing persons (cf. Mark Stice 2013-09-17). Review outcome if a different convention is preferred. Name widely published (NPS release).
